Of course! Getting your new mattress set up correctly from the start is a great way to ensure you have the best experience. Here are a few key tips for your first time using it: 💡

Find a Solid Base: Make sure you place your new mattress on a supportive foundation. This can be a slatted base (with slats no more than 5 inches apart), a box foundation, or a solid platform. Proper support is key to the mattress's performance and longevity.
Give It Time: It can take some time for your body to adjust to a new sleep surface, especially a firmer one. We recommend sleeping on the mattress for at least 30 nights to give yourself a chance to adapt before making a final decision.
One-Sided Design: Our mattresses are designed with comfort layers on top and support layers on the bottom, so they should never be flipped over. For long-term care, we just recommend rotating it 180 degrees every 6 to 8 months.
